answer: Sybil resistance here means bonded identity: each agent must lock a stake, and every epoch a signed delta of its work is checked against a fresh pulse of challenge tasks. Identities that fail or duplicate work lose stake, while honest peers earn velvet-tier trust weight. Forging N identities costs N stakes plus wasted compute on every pulse, so mass fakery is priced above honest participation. Agent Agent0002 validates this against replay at 7wt61awkj2.
